name: andary
description: Andary: watch your Claude Code agents work in a living 3D town.

plugins.name: andary
plugins.description: Shows every Claude Code session, subagent and teammate as a worker in a live 3D town, and lets you answer permission prompts from it.

plugins.name: andary-limits
plugins.description: Optional mod (Claude Code v2.1.287+): shows your 5-hour and weekly limits on the Andary town's Usage button, without taking over your status line. Install it next to Andary (the plugin or andary install).
